blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these are equal to four times the quantity x minus three? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Select all the expressions that equal 4(x − 3).

blocks.text: Four x minus twelve. Four times x is four x, and four times negative three is negative twelve. Equal.
Four x minus three. Here only the x was multiplied by four. The three needs it too. Not equal.
Negative twelve plus four x. The same two terms in another order. Equal.
Four x plus twelve. The sign is wrong. Four times negative three is negative twelve. Not equal.
x times four, minus three times four. Each term is multiplied by four, just not calculated yet. Equal.
So three of them are equal. Four times x is four x, and four times negative three is negative twelve, in any order.
